items.title: Guardrails and cost control for your agentic workloads with Amazon Redshift
items.summary: AI agents are becoming major consumers of warehouse data, and two risks decide whether they reach production: excessive agency and unbounded consumption. Learn how to run agentic analytics on Amazon Redshift safely and without runaway costs, using one model: six guardrails, three enforcement layers, and one cost envelope.
items.creator: Jason Pedreza
